description: Extends Leaflet's MarkerClusterGroup and L.Marker classes with methods to refresh cluster icons and marker icons, particularly for updating parent cluster icons and handling single marker mode.

classes.name: L.MarkerClusterGroup
classes.description: A class extended with methods to refresh cluster icons and handle marker updates.

classes.name: L.Marker
classes.description: A class extended with a method to update icon options and refresh the marker.

methods.name: refreshClusters
methods.description: Updates the icon of all parent clusters of specified markers and optionally refreshes their icons; also updates markers in singleMarkerMode.

methods.name: _flagParentsIconsNeedUpdate
methods.description: Flags all parent clusters of given markers as needing icon update.

methods.name: _refreshSingleMarkerModeMarkers
methods.description: Re-draws icons for specified markers in singleMarkerMode.

methods.name: refreshIconOptions
methods.description: Updates marker icon options and optionally refreshes parent clusters.
